findings.title: Organisation and pharmacy admins are treated as invoice issuers instead of recipients on legacy invoice detail view
findings.scenario: Sara completes a shift for Tom's pharmacy, which is managed by Lina at the organisation level and Grace as the pharmacy admin, and issues an invoice. When Lina or Grace opens the invoice in their manager dashboard, the page mistakes them for the invoice issuer because their user role is not pharmacy owner. Instead of seeing the recipient document with bank details and the ability to mark the invoice as paid or report an issue, Lina and Grace are shown an editable contractor draft with Sara's banking and line items, and their attempts to save or manage payment are rejected.
findings.test_needed: An Organisation Admin or delegated Pharmacy Admin viewing a received invoice in their dashboard is rendered the read-only recipient document with payment and issue reporting actions rather than the editable contractor form.

owner_question.question: When Lina (organisation admin) or Grace (pharmacy admin) reviews an invoice issued by Sara for work at their pharmacy, what view and actions should they have?
options: Display the read-only recipient invoice with pay-to bank details, 'Mark as paid', and 'Report an issue' actions
Restrict invoice review and payment marking strictly to the pharmacy owner (Tom)
